dossier.purpose: Rust static-analysis CLI that audits GitHub Actions workflows/actions, Dependabot configs and pre-commit configs for security issues (41 audits, crates/zizmor/src/registry.rs:48-88). Outputs plain, JSON, SARIF 2.1.0 or GitHub annotations; can auto-fix a subset; offline by default, extra online audits with a GitHub token. It is not an SBOM generator, attestation signer, dependency-update bot or general workflow/shell linter.

claims.claim: zizmor is a static analysis tool for CI/CD systems.
Finds and fixes security issues in GitHub Actions, Dependabot and pre-commit.
Finds template injection, credential persistence/leakage, excessive permission scopes, impostor commits and confusable git refs, and more.
MIT licensed; README has no install commands, it points to the external docs site.
Docs: designed for GitHub Actions; easiest route is external zizmorcore/zizmor-action; manual routes are --format=sarif (code scanning) or --format=github (annotations).
Docs: SARIF upload needs security-events: write and github/codeql-action/upload-sarif with category: zizmor; public repos or GHEC with Advanced Security.
Docs: with --format=sarif zizmor exits 0 unless an internal error occurs, so the workflow stays green.
Docs: three modes (offline, online, online sans audits); default is offline unless GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN/ZIZMOR_GITHUB_TOKEN is set.
Docs: unpinned-uses applies blanket hash-pinning by default (since v1.20.0); per-pattern policies hash-pin/ref-pin/any are configurable.
Docs: excessive-permissions remediation is permissions: {} at workflow level plus minimal job-level permissions.
Docs: --fix[=safe|unsafe-only|all] edits in place, no remote inputs; unpinned-uses fixes need online access; Dependabot/Renovate suggested for keeping pins current.
Docs: static analysis only, never executes code, audits definitions only (not referenced scripts); 'not a panacea'.
Docs: wheels and release binaries are best-effort; Conda, Nix, Arch, Chimera, Alpine packages are community-maintained.
Docs: LSP, YAML anchors, parallel steps are experimental/beta; pre-commit support was introduced as experimental.

readme.telemetry_and_network: No telemetry/analytics code found; the only HTTP client code is crates/zizmor/src/github.rs (repo-wide search). Offline unless a token is set (cli.rs:185-215; main.rs:298-305, 343-357; docs/usage.md:148-156). Online mode contacts the GitHub host (default github.com, override --gh-hostname/GH_HOST; github.rs:37-75): REST API (github.rs:632, 724, 747, 776, 824, 881), git-upload-pack ls-refs with the token as basic auth (github.rs:393-421), and undocumented /branch_commits/ without token (github.rs:685-698). User-Agent zizmor/<version> (utils.rs:12). Needs only a GitHub token (contents: read for private repos; docs/usage.md:205-216). HTTP responses cached on disk in a user cache dir that may hold sensitive metadata (cli.rs:48-58; docs/usage.md:950-975). main.rs:440 installs the human_panic hook (crate not in repo; behaviour unverified). v1.27.0 logged GitHub credentials in cleartext, fixed in 1.28.0 (docs/release-notes.md:145-151); the token is now masked (github.rs:113-125).

entry_points.what: zizmor binary: main (l.438-446) -> run (l.124-436): CLI, input collection, audits per input, output, --fix, exit code
Experimental stdio LSP server started by --lsp
AuditRegistry registers 41 audits; FindingRegistry filters by persona/severity/confidence/ignores
Audit trait and one module per audit
SARIF 2.1.0 emitter (driver zizmor, rule ids zizmor/<audit>); siblings plain.rs, json/v1.rs, github.rs, fix.rs
GitHub REST + git ls-refs client with HTTP cache, used by online audits and remote inputs
Embeds crates/zizmor/data (context capabilities, CodeQL sinks, archived-repos FSTs); no network

code.architecture: Cargo workspace of 9 crates (Cargo.toml:2-12). crates/zizmor collects inputs (files, dirs, GitHub slugs, stdin; registry/input.rs), parses them into models (src/models/*) validated against embedded JSON schemas (src/data/*.json; models.rs:81-148) using github-actions-models, github-actions-expressions, yamlpath/yamlpatch/subfeature (tree-sitter-yaml spans and format-preserving patches). 41 audits in src/audit/*.rs; permission/pinning relevant: excessive_permissions, undocumented_permissions, unpinned_uses, unpinned_images, unpinned_tools, forbidden_uses (allow/deny), ref_version_mismatch, stale_action_refs, impostor_commit, ref_confusion, known_vulnerable_actions, archived_uses, typosquat_uses, adhoc_packages, dependabot_cooldown, github_app, secrets_*. Online-only audits skip when offline (impostor_commit.rs:273-282). Only three audits parse run: shell with tree-sitter bash/pwsh (use_trusted_publishing.rs, adhoc_packages.rs, github_env.rs). Not present: SBOM (CycloneDX/SPDX) generation, attestation creation, dependency-update PRs, checking with: inputs/outputs against a referenced action.yml, general linting. unsafe_code is forbidden workspace-wide (Cargo.toml:110-112); no subprocess spawning in crates/zizmor/src.
code.packaging_and_release: Tag v* runs release.yml:17-127: creates a DRAFT GitHub release (l.72; no step here publishes it) and calls four workflows. (1) release-binaries.yml: cargo build --release (no --locked, l.52) for x86_64/aarch64 linux-gnu, x86_64/aarch64 apple-darwin, x86_64 windows-msvc (l.20-30); tar.gz/zip via support/archive-release.sh; actions/attest on distrib/* (l.93-97); no checksum file. (2) release-pypi.yml: maturin wheels (manylinux, musllinux, Windows, macOS) + sdist, uv publish --trusted-publishing=always (l.173-175); attest step commented out with TODO (l.167-171); also builds on every push to main (l.3-6). (3) release-crates.yml: cargo publish --workspace via crates.io Trusted Publishing (l.29-35). (4) release-docker.yml: external docker/github-builder@v1.17.0 (SHA-pinned) to ghcr.io/zizmorcore/zizmor, linux/amd64+arm64 (l.63-75); image installs zizmor from PyPI on cgr.dev/chainguard/wolfi-base:latest (Dockerfile:15-37; release.yml:115). rust-toolchain.toml pins 1.97.0; MSRV 1.97.0 (Cargo.toml:18).
code.tests_and_ci: cargo test + insta snapshots + assert_cmd (crates/zizmor/Cargo.toml:67-72). About 59 Rust test files under crates/*/tests (51 in crates/zizmor/tests/integration, 8 in other crates), 43 files with inline cfg(test) modules, about 628 #[test]/#[tokio::test] lines in 98 files; 343 files under crates/zizmor/tests (snapshots, YAML data). Feature-gated online-tests, gh-token-tests, crater-tests, tty-tests, schema (crates/zizmor/Cargo.toml:81-93). Python pytest-codspeed benches in bench/ (pyproject.toml:18-24; docs/development.md:190-214). 11 workflows: ci.yml (fmt, clippy -D warnings, cargo test with crater-tests,tty-tests,schema on ubuntu/macos/windows with GH_TOKEN, snippet/schema drift, site build, gate), zizmor.yml (self-scan of ./.github/ via zizmor-action, security-events: write), benchmark.yml (CodSpeed), codegen.yml (weekly draft PRs), release*.yml (5), site.yml, test-output.yml. Workflows use permissions: {} and SHA-pinned actions; dependabot.yml weekly, grouped, 7-day cooldown for uv, cargo, github-actions, docker; pinact only for docs (.github/pinact.yml:4-7).
code.dependencies: Workspace Cargo.toml lists 61 [workspace.dependencies] (53 external + 8 path crates); Cargo.lock committed with 450 packages. Direct [dependencies]: zizmor 50 (2 optional; +1 jemalloc, 2 build, 5 dev; crates/zizmor/Cargo.toml:15-79), github-actions-expressions 3, github-actions-models 5, pre-commit-models 3, subfeature 3, tree-sitter-iter 1, yamlpatch 7, yamlpath 7, zizmor-sarif 2. Notable: reqwest 0.13, http-cache-reqwest 1.0.0-alpha.7 (Cargo.toml:49), tree-sitter 0.26 with exact =0.26.4 powershell grammar (Cargo.toml:83). Python (docs/bench only): pytest, pytest-codspeed, urllib3, zensical; maturin build backend (pyproject.toml:1-24; uv.lock).
code.security_policy: none - no SECURITY.md in the checkout. Advisories are published via GitHub Security Advisories (GHSA-f42p-wjw5-97qh; docs/release-notes.md:145-151, 2112). The AI/contribution policy lives in the external zizmorcore/.github repo (not read).

claim_checks.claim: README.md:10-13: tool for CI/CD systems that finds and fixes issues in GitHub Actions, Dependabot, pre-commit
claim_checks.evidence: Input kinds are only workflows, actions, Dependabot, pre-commit config/hooks (registry/input.rs:131-142; cli.rs:500-515). Fixes exist in only 13 of 41 audit files (grep for .fix(). --fix is labelled EXPERIMENTAL in --help (cli.rs:91) but docs say stable since v1.15.0 (docs/usage.md:712-715). docs/audits.md:1021 still marks impostor-commit auto-fix, but impostor_commit.rs has no fix code and release-notes.md:275-277 says removed in 1.26.0.

excessive_permissions.rs:150-247 flags missing permissions block (Medium), read-all (Medium), write-all (High) at workflow and job level, and per-scope write at workflow level via severity map (l.14-37). Limit: explicit job-level permission blocks are never evaluated (l.240-244).

claim_checks.claim: README.md:18: impostor commits and confusable git refs
claim_checks.evidence: Implemented but online-only: impostor_commit.rs:273-282 and ref_confusion.rs:75-84 skip without a token or with no_online_audits; docs mark Works offline no (docs/audits.md:1021, 1405). Default run is offline without a token (main.rs:343-357), so they do not run by default.

claim_checks.claim: docs/audits.md:2198-2199: unpinned-uses applies blanket hash-pinning by default
claim_checks.evidence: Default HashPin (config/mod.rs:394-400, 418); finding built at unpinned_uses.rs:151-167 (High). Hash means exactly 40 hex chars (models/repo_ref.rs:154-160); Docker uses needs a digest (models/uses.rs:303); container images via unpinned_images.rs:79-91 (non-latest tag is pedantic only). Default changed in v1.20.0 (docs/release-notes.md:711-716).

claim_checks.claim: docs/audits.md:2300-2322, usage.md:735-782: --fix hash-pins; Dependabot/Renovate keep pins current
claim_checks.evidence: Pin fix requires a token (unpinned_uses.rs:32-33), only version-like refs (l.45-54), writes SHA plus '# <tag>' comment (l.85-111), has default disposition Unsafe (l.97; finding.rs:78-87) so plain --fix skips it (output/fix.rs:36-41). Already-pinned refs are never bumped (l.40-43): zizmor opens no PRs and does not update dependencies. The repo itself uses Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml) and pinact for docs only.

claim_checks.claim: docs/integrations.md:112-116, 129-132: SARIF feeds code scanning; exit 0 in SARIF mode
claim_checks.evidence: SARIF 2.1.0 with driver name zizmor, version, rules zizmor/<id>, locations, codeflows (output/sarif.rs:37-66, 85, 140-163); exit 0 for SARIF (main.rs:428-429). Output has no partialFingerprints, commit SHA or category (repo-wide search); commit/tool/category binding comes from the separate upload-sarif step or zizmor-action, whose code is not in this repo.

claim_checks.claim: docs/usage.md:148-156: offline by default unless a token is set
claim_checks.evidence: Client built only with a token (main.rs:300-305); --offline clears the token (main.rs:209-211); warning when implicitly offline (main.rs:343-357); LSP always offline (lsp.rs:406; state.rs:21-28).

claim_checks.claim: docs/usage.md:1009-1083: static only, never executes code, definitions only
claim_checks.evidence: No process spawning in crates/zizmor/src (only ExitCode, registry.rs:4). Shell run: blocks are parsed by three audits only (use_trusted_publishing.rs:347-356, adhoc_packages.rs:100-108, github_env.rs:358-366). Expression parse failures only warn (template_injection.rs:378-381; unsound_ternary.rs:47-50). Schema/syntax checks warn, or fail with --strict-collection (models.rs:81-148; docs/usage.md:122-129). fetch_single_file callers are only github.rs:850 and config/mod.rs:709, so with: inputs/outputs are never checked against an action.yml. Not a general workflow/expression/script linter.

claim_checks.evidence: PyPI attest step is commented out with a TODO (release-pypi.yml:167-171); publish is uv publish --trusted-publishing=always (l.175); whether uv emits attestations is outside this repo. But l.108-111 does 'return Ok(findings)' inside the for loop, so the first update meeting the minimum ends the audit and later updates entries are not checked; the multi-update test only has below-threshold entries (tests/integration/audit/dependabot_cooldown.rs:316-359). Code-reading observation, not executed.

risks: Governance concentration: copyright holder is a single named individual (LICENSE:3); sponsorship links and automated-PR assignee/reviewer point to the same handle (README.md:114-116; .github/workflows/codegen.yml:11); contributions must follow an AI policy hosted outside this repo (docs/development.md:13-16).

Behavior drift in minor releases: unpinned-uses default became hash-pin for all actions in 1.20.0 (docs/release-notes.md:711-716); secrets-outside-env moved to auditor persona in 1.24.0 (docs/audits.md:1574-1581); unpinned-uses/unpinned-images responsibilities split in 1.29.0 (release-notes.md:119-122). Docs pin ZIZMOR_VERSION in CI examples (docs/integrations.md:85-108).

Scope gaps for supply-chain needs: no SBOM generation, no provenance/attestation creation for user outputs, no dependency-update PRs, no checking of with: inputs/outputs against action.yml, not a shell/expression linter (see claim_checks 8). The pin fix is online, unsafe-class and limited to version-like refs (unpinned_uses.rs:32-54, 97).

Default-offline: impostor-commit, ref-confusion, ref-version-mismatch, stale-action-refs, known-vulnerable-actions need a token (impostor_commit.rs:273-282; main.rs:343-357). In CI the default GITHUB_TOKEN cannot read other private repos, causing 'can't access ORG/REPO' errors (docs/troubleshooting.md:46-115).
Possible under-reporting in dependabot-cooldown: early return at dependabot_cooldown.rs:108-111 can skip later updates entries (code reading only; not executed).

Release integrity gaps: PyPI attestation step disabled (release-pypi.yml:167-171); no checksum files for binaries (release-binaries.yml:93-105); release created as draft with no publishing step (release.yml:72); builds lack --locked (release-binaries.yml:52; release-pypi.yml:49); Docker image is assembled from the PyPI package on unpinned wolfi-base:latest with unpinned apk add uv (Dockerfile:15-24, 30).

Platform/build: binaries and wheels are best-effort with libc compatibility caveats (docs/installation.md:28-31, 177-181); source builds need Rust 1.97.0 (Cargo.toml:18) and an alpha http-cache dependency (Cargo.toml:49; main.rs:225-229); cargo install without --locked can fail on yanked deps (docs/troubleshooting.md:11-42); WSL2 undocumented.

Security history and maturity: v1.27.0 logged GitHub credentials in cleartext (docs/release-notes.md:145-151); no SECURITY.md in the repo; LSP, YAML anchors, parallel steps and pre-commit support are experimental/beta (docs/integrations.md:214-224; docs/usage.md:1085-1127); --fix edits files in place (docs/usage.md:770-771).
